  # Memory the collector gives back to the system must come back zero: each

  def keys(round: integer): list[tuple[string, integer]] do

  end

  def round(r: integer, sum: integer): integer do
    if r == 0 do sum else
      kept = junk(20000)
      used = byte_size(Enum.at(kept, rem(r, 100), ""))
      m = Map.new(keys(r))
      round(r - 1, sum + used + map_size(m) + Enum.sum(Map.values(m)))
    end
  end

    IO.puts(inspect(List.foldl([4, 5], 1, Piped.apply_to(0, fn _ -> [fn n, acc -> n * acc end] end) |> first_of())))
  end
end

defmodule Tried do
  def reduce_ok(r: result[integer, string]): result[integer, string] do

  end

  def main() do
    kept = try do
      tap(ok([1, 5, 42]), fn v -> IO.puts(inspect(v)) end)
    rescue
